lines.text: God put into the heart of Titus the same devotion the writer has, and Titus is eagerly coming.
Paul sends with Titus a brother praised by all the churches for his work in the temple.
We want to avoid criticism of the gift's administration and take care to do right before the Lord and men.
Paul boasted to the Macedonians that since last year the Corinthians in Galatia were prepared to give.
The brothers are urged to visit beforehand and arrange the promised gift, so it is prepared generously, not begrudgingly.
